construction.implementation_origin: Original bounded implementation created from scratch

shared_schema.input: Exact envelope: schema_version=1, synthetic_data=true, records (1..100). Each record has record_id, patient_record, clinical_note, prior_authorization_request.
shared_schema.patient_record: FHIR-style Patient with SYN-PAT-nnnn id, synthetic=true, diagnoses [{code: SYN-DX-token}], labs [{code: SYN-LAB-token, value: finite number in [-1e9,1e9], unit: arb}]. Collections have at most 100 unique codes.
shared_schema.clinical_note: FHIR-style DocumentReference with SYN-NOTE-nnnn id, matching subject.reference and text up to 4000 characters. Empty text is valid missing evidence. Closed lines: Diagnosis: SYN-DX-token; Lab: SYN-LAB-token = decimal arb; Documentation: synthetic encounter recorded.
shared_schema.prior_authorization_request: FHIR-style Claim with SYN-PA-nnnn id, use=preauthorization, matching patient.reference, SYN-SVC-token service_code, 1..100 unique requirements {id: REQ-nnn, source: diagnosis|lab|clinical_note, code: matching synthetic code or documentation}. Tokens contain 1..12 uppercase letters/digits.
shared_schema.output: Shared versioned envelope retaining validated synthetic records, adding review to each, status=reviewed, mandatory human_review_required=true and one audit_trail change event per record. Error envelope: status=error, error=safe message.
shared_schema.validation: Single validate function used by library and CLI before any changes. Exact fields and types, synthetic-only identifiers, bounded arrays, matching patient references, duplicate code/identifier rejection, finite lab values. CLI rejects duplicate JSON keys, non-finite constants and files over 1 MB.

cross_stage_handoffs: One stage only: validated immutable input snapshot -> deterministic document review -> copied records with traceable checks and audit events.

behavior.requirement_checking: Exact code presence for diagnosis/lab requirements and exact synthetic documentation line for clinical-note requirements; values are never interpreted medically.
behavior.gaps: Each check includes requirement id/path, expected code, source, evidence path (with 1-based note line when relevant), status and explanation.
behavior.human_review: Always required even when all evidence is present. No clinical or authorization decisions are performed.
behavior.de_identification: Demonstrative HIPAA-oriented identifier exclusion: reject patient name, birthDate, identifier/MRN, addresses, contact fields and all other unsupported fields. Reject unrestricted clinical prose rather than attempting unsafe automatic redaction. Accept only clearly labeled fictitious synthetic identifiers and closed note grammar; not a HIPAA certification or complete real-world de-identification system.
behavior.audit: Every internal record change is a single review-field addition with deterministic sequence, actor, record id, exact path, added value and canonical before/after SHA-256 hashes. Source records are never mutated. Sequence substitutes for wall-clock time for deterministic runs; trail is not a signed, tamper-proof or persisted audit service.
behavior.fixture: Clearly labeled fictitious Synthea-style patient, invented diagnosis codes and arbitrary-unit lab values; no actual Synthea export, real MRNs, names or birth dates.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, clock use, network calls, providers or LLM steps.

included: Audit event for every review-field addition
FHIR-style JSON and constrained clinical note text

test_outcomes.cli: Passed: example input printed one JSON object with status reviewed and exited 0. Missing-file and usage errors printed JSON with status error and exited 2.
test_outcomes.example_result: Three requirements have evidence; one missing lab is a traceable gap; human review is mandatory; one record-change audit event.
